data.name: Kiaan
data.gender_notes: Kiaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kshyan', meaning 'desire'. In Hindu mythology, Kiaan represents the divine grace bestowed upon an individual. The name Kiaan carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kiaan usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kiaan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiaan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

He is considered a jina or a saint in Jainism, and is also revered in Hinduism as a sage and an incarnation of Lord Shiva.
